# Sourpuss

> Find and rate the best whisky sours in your city

A good whisky sour is worth remembering. Find your next one. Keep notes on the last.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sourpuss.app/): Main landing page with app features and download link
- [Privacy Policy](https://sourpuss.app/privacy): How we collect, use, and protect user data
- [Support](https://sourpuss.app/support): FAQs and contact information

## Key Features

- Find a place: Look around the map, read reviews and pick somewhere for a whisky sour
- Remember the drink: The balance, the glass, the first sip
- Compare notes: See which places other reviewers rate
- Keep a short list: Save places for another night, and keep the ones you would go back to close at hand

## Contact

- Email: support@sourpuss.app
- Website: https://sourpuss.app
